_about: The world of Tre: the whole of Vietnam as regions, one for each story chapter, in history order. The whole country is one plane of cells; a region is a named area of it. Each region has 3 to 6 story places (maps: the files in data/maps/, each the frame of a place on the plane). A region with no maps is a locked area on the country map. when: the condition that opens the region (see src/core/conditions.js). start: the region and the place (its spawn) of a new game. entry: the point where the hero arrives after a travel ([place, x, y]: a cell in the frame of a place). The roads and rivers between regions are in data/world/routes.json. places: the story places of the region, with names on the map when the region is open. seeds: more points ([longitude, latitude]) of the land of the region, so that the area of the region on the map follows the real land; the area of a region is the land that is nearer to its place or seeds than to those of other regions. eraKey: the name of the era of the story in the region (on the profile cards and in the parent area); a region with maps has one. place: the story place at the center of the region (see data/geo/vietnam.json); the seal of the region is there on the country map. land: the file of the land of the region in data/world/ (the frames of its places on the plane, the rivers, the roads; src/core/gen/).

eraLand._about: The land of each era on the country map: the land north of this latitude (degrees) is the land of the chapter. The land to the south is drawn faint and has no names. The values follow the south border of the country in each time, and need a check.
